title: Tamil "தீவிர" (severe) is read as "தீ" (fire): Tamil severe-case questions answer about fires
what_happens: "அடையாறு தீவிர புகார்கள் காட்டு" gives slots cat=FIRE_EXPLOSION and says there are no severe cases today. The same question in English finds 1 severe case in Adyar. Same for Anna Nagar in Tamil.
what_should_happen: Tamil and English give the same cases; "தீவிர" must not match the fire word.
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/hunt-jarvis1.test.ts (run in chennai-grievance-portal-main); test JARVIS1-1
evidence: chennai-grievance-portal-main/tests/qa/pass4/hunt-jarvis1.test.ts (JARVIS1-1, it.fails, real path via client-sim, no model)
root_cause_guess: src/lib/thunai/quick.ts catIn (line ~79): Tamil words are matched with t.indexOf(w), a substring, so "தீ" (lexicon.ts:78) hits inside "தீவிர"
class: substring match of a short Tamil word
skeptic_why: Re-ran tests/qa/pass4/hunt-jarvis1.test.ts myself: all 12 it.fails pass, so each bug still reproduces (in-process, no model, no server; free RAM was 1.3 GB so port 3190 was not started). Code read: quick.ts catIn uses t.indexOf(w) for Tamil words, and lexicon.ts:78 has the 2-letter word தீ, which sits inside தீவிர. This runs in the quick lane before any model. P0 stands: a confident wrong answer (none today vs 1 severe).
